name: TOXOPLASMA - IgG ANTIBODY
description: Toxoplasma IgG Antibody detects past or chronic Toxoplasma gondii infection. This test evaluates immunity status and risk assessment in pregnancy and immunocompromised patients.

testdetails.instrumentation: Abbott Architect, Roche Elecsys, Beckman Coulter

literatureReview: Toxoplasma IgG Antibody indicates past or latent Toxoplasma gondii infection. Positive result (>8 IU/mL) suggests immunity and low risk of acute infection. Negative result indicates susceptibility and higher risk. Used in prenatal screening to identify women needing preventive measures. In immunocompromised patients, positive IgG indicates possible reactivation risk. Chemiluminescent immunoassay provides high sensitivity and specificity. Should be interpreted with IgM results for acute infection diagnosis. Avidity testing can help distinguish recent from past infection. Critical for congenital toxoplasmosis prevention and management of immunocompromised patients.
